title: Symmetric functions have equal-size coefficients
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube that is invariant under every permutation of its coordinates. For any coordinate sets $S$ and $T$ with $|S|=|T|$, the Fourier coefficients of $f$ at $S$ and $T$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$f$ is invariant under every permutation of coordinates
